concepts.name: The Windbreak Cypress
concepts.rationale: A wind-swept Monterey cypress on the headland meadow, its flat crown streaming inland, the cliff edge to the sea.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no background, in the house style (developer 2026-10-25: no circular badges).
